about: The table of the UI layering guard (#959): scripts/check-ui-layering.py holds ui/src to it, crates/barca-cli/src/ui_layering_tests.rs holds it to the CLI and the server. How to extend it: site/src/content/docs/contributing/ui-layering.md.

routes.cli: barca sql "select status, count(*) from barca.runs group by all" --server --json

exempt.reason: Write command: replay the durable request scope, optionally narrowed to a recorded step.
auth: trades the one-use code `barca tokens bootstrap` prints for a token; a credential exchange, not a pipeline answer
auth: whether this server asks for a token, read before any credential exists
auth: token management is the browser's after bootstrap; a token is never printed twice, so there is nothing for a CLI to show beyond `barca tokens bootstrap`
connection probe: liveness, read-only mode and capabilities of this server, which every CLI command that takes --server reads for itself; no pipeline answer
page chrome: the project root (to shorten traceback paths) and the telemetry link; no pipeline answer
event stream: `barca get --server` and `barca logs --follow` follow the same stream; a stream has no JSON document to compare

routes.cli: barca status NODE --keys --state failed --value region=apac --range day=2026-01-01..2026-01-31 --error 0 --match apac --sort attempted --limit 200 --offset 0 --json

api.does: typed request wrappers over the server's routes

apiBase.does: where the API is, from where the UI is served

credentials.does: the tab's credentials and the one fetch transport

eventStream.does: the run event stream: decoding, resume and reconnect

types.does: re-exports the generated wire types and the few shapes the server builds by hand

cacheStateDisplay.does: a cache state's word, tone, glyph and rank; a node that always runs drawn by its served `last_attempt`

healthDisplay.does: a health's word, tone, glyph and order; a tick outcome's word

causeDisplay.does: a cause's word, tone, glyph and map colour; the served order

keyStateDisplay.does: a key state's word, glyph, meaning and order; the state a character of a served row stands for

dataSignals.does: the words of a node's data signals and of the coverage the server measured

glyph.does: the glyph of each state and tone

status.does: the run lifecycle's word, tone and glyph; kind and freshness labels

derives.what: `isCheck`: a task named `check__…` or `validate__…` is labelled and counted as a check
derives.reason: `check` is a kind only the UI knows, read off a naming convention. Whether it becomes a kind the server knows or goes is an open product decision (#1056, "Open decisions"), so no server-side kind is invented here

tone.does: the tones every display table maps onto

runs.does: a run's status, trigger and outcome, a run's step and node, and whether one recorded execution succeeded or failed, as word, tone and glyph

derives.what: `parseRunStatus`: a run's wire `status` (a string) narrowed to the generated `RunViewStatus`; `complete` and `ran`, older spellings, read as `success`
derives.reason: display: compatibility with rows an older server recorded; the status is the served one and none is decided from other facts

graphState.does: a node's box on the graph: its served cause (or fresh) in the health map's word, or the run on it, as a glyph and a word

causesView.does: the to-do list's words: a scope's `held_by` joined with the rollup's roots; data signals apart

artifactSchema.does: an artifact's columns and sample rows as a table

documentTitle.does: the tab's title from the route

nodeDetail.does: the node panel's lines from the node's served row

derives.what: `downstreamOf` by name, `barSegments`' widest part, `changedSummary`'s tally of the served `changed` entries by their first word, `collapseRuns`: a stretch of identical failed runs of the History as one line `×12`
derives.reason: presentation: the order of a list of names, the widths of a bar, and the folding of rows on screen that say the same thing; each row is shown as served and nothing about the node is concluded from them

derives.what: `whatChanged`, `failuresOnlyNote`, `dataKeyNote`: sentences for the served `change_causes`, `total_runs`, `consecutive_failures` and the key of `last_materialization`
derives.reason: presentation: wording of served values; `barca status --json` and `barca stats --json` print the values the sentences are made of

derives.what: `dataKey`: which output the Data tab opens for a partitioned node: the key of its served `last_materialization`
derives.reason: page: a choice of what to show first, not a statement about the node; the key explorer lists every key as served

derives.what: `sinceLastSuccess`: which of five sentences says what differs between a failed attempt and the last success, decided by comparing three served run hashes (`failure.run_hash`, `failure.last_success.run_hash`, `cache.run_hash`)
derives.reason: a real derivation with no served field: two facts make a third. Owed to barca-service as a word on the failure facts (#1056, F3 "what changed"); left out of this change to keep its new fields few

pipeline.does: file names from node ids; a file's line from its sums in the rollup, in the health map's words

derives.what: `pipelineSummaries`: the project's files by name, each with how many of its nodes are of the page's kind
derives.reason: layout: a count of the listed graph (`GET /assets`) by declared kind, shown before any state has loaded. The rollup serves the same numbers (`kinds`, `files` of `GET /state/rollup`) but arrives later, and three e2e specs hold the sidebar's counts visible before it does; the graph is the only response the sidebar has at that moment

queue.does: `GET /queue` as the queue strip's rows and labels

derives.what: the queue list's order: the running runs by `queued_at`, the waiting ones by their served `position`
derives.reason: presentation: an order of served rows by served fields; the place of a waiting run is the server's

derives.what: `queueStatus`: how long the run waiting longest has waited
derives.reason: format: a duration since a served time (`queued_at`), re-counted between polls against the browser's clock like every `ago`; which runs wait is the server's list

running.does: what a run in progress says of a node: elapsed, keys done, links

schedules.does: scheduled nodes as rows: next slot, last tick, the server's `late` and `queue_bound`, its typical queue wait and run time in words

derives.what: the Schedules page's order: late first (by the served `late_since`), then queue-bound, then the next slot, then the name
derives.reason: presentation: an order of rows by fields each was served with; whether a schedule is late or queue-bound is the server's

time.does: the one time format: relative, absolute, zones

estimates.does: when a node or a scope is fresh, in words: the served `expected_fresh_at`, `recheck_at` and `no_estimate` of a row, `fresh_by` and `unbounded` of a rollup entry

health.does: the rollup's failure roots joined with their rows as the failures list; an error's one line and its traceback's paths

derives.what: `consumersOf`, `downstreamIds`: the node panel's downstream count and what a pause with `--downstream` would cover
derives.reason: layout: a walk of the static graph (`inputs` of `GET /assets`, which `barca list --json` prints) for navigation; it reads no state and decides no health

assetTable.does: the flat assets table: rows from served rows (the served `typical_run_seconds` and `last_attempt` among them), the served order of the causes, sort, file headers

derives.what: the table's order: the served order of the causes by default, then the column a header click picks
derives.reason: layout: an order of the rows on screen by served fields (`cause`, `typical_run_seconds`, the times); which cause a row has, and its typical run time, are the server's

graph.does: assets as positioned graph nodes and edges

graphLayout.does: dagre layout per connected part and edge routes

derives.what: the packing of the graph's connected parts: their order by size and the area they take
derives.reason: layout: geometry of boxes on a canvas; reads no state

graphLayout.worker.does: the layout, off the main thread

derives.what: nodes by their position on the canvas, for the first fit and the keyboard's neighbours
derives.reason: layout: an order of drawn boxes by x and y

groups.does: the tree of groups, each listing the members the rollup counts under it; a group's box from its entry's served `causes`, in the health map's words

derives.what: `contentsSummary`: what a group holds by kind, `3 assets · 1 check`
derives.reason: layout: counts of the listed graph by declared kind (`check` is the name convention of lib/status, see there); reads no state

lineage.does: the lineage drawn in place of a graph too big to read

partitionGrid.does: the overview's geometry over the served rows of a node's keys: columns, ticks, a zoom window, the key a cell stands for

derives.what: `heatmap`: a column's colour is the most urgent state among the keys it holds
derives.reason: layout: many served key states drawn as one cell, as wide as the window allows; no key's state is decided

rollupView.does: the rollup indexed by id and the geometry of the health map over it: a segment's angle from its entry's served `weight`, its colours from the served `weights`

derives.what: the health map's geometry: a segment's angle from the served `weight`s, with thin segments folded into one
derives.reason: layout: sums of served weights turned into angles; no weight is made here (`weights` and `weight` are served)

derives.what: `rootsWithin`: the served roots whose own node is underneath a scope, for the scope's failures list
derives.reason: layout: which served roots are about a node listed in the scope (a membership test of `root.node`). The roots that hold a scope from outside it are the to-do list's, read from the scope's served `held_by` (lib/causesView); the failures list is of the nodes on screen

assetFilters.does: the assets table's filters in the URL; a row falls under its served cause, an unfiltered chip's count is the rollup's (`kinds`), a filtered one counts the rows listed

derives.what: `facetCounts`: a filter chip's count under a search or another filter
derives.reason: presentation: a count of the rows listed, by a field each row was served with (`cause`, `kind`, `pinned`); with no other filter the state chips show the rollup's own counts (`kinds` of `GET /state/rollup`)

groupedPage.does: the grouped page: URL, scope, entries, search hits, order

derives.what: `scopeCountsLabel`: the nodes in scope by declared kind; the grouped table's order (the column picked, search hits by how well they match, the order held while the pointer is over the table)
derives.reason: layout: counts of the listed graph (`GET /assets`, which `barca list --json` prints) by `kind`, and the order of rows on screen; no state is read and no node's standing decided

keysPage.does: the key explorer's URL, and its filters as the parameters `GET /assets/{id}/partitions/keys` takes

knownStates.does: the last state loaded for each node, kept across navigation

palette.does: the command palette's index, search and program

derives.what: the palette's lists: files by name, keys and runs by the urgency of their shown state, search hits by how well they match
derives.reason: presentation: the order of a list on screen; each item's state is the one its row was served with

pauses.does: what is paused, the request a pause control sends, and what a pause would cover as the server says it (`covers` of `GET /pauses?target=`) joined with each schedule's job

derives.what: `affectedSchedules`: the served schedules of a pause's cover, soonest next tick first
derives.reason: presentation: an order of a served list by a served time (`next_fire` of `GET /schedule`); which schedules a pause covers, and how each touches the node, is computed in barca-service (`refresh_path::pause_cover`, the scheduler's own walk)

program.does: model, message, effect: how a page with state is written

runFeedback.does: a node's run status as the feedback a panel shows

derives.what: `runOutcomeSummary`: `7 keys failed`, the sum of a finished run's per-node `failed` counts (or its failed key steps)
derives.reason: a sum over served rows that no field serves as one number (`steps_failed` counts steps that are not keys too). Owed to barca-service as a field of the run view

runRecovery.does: what a page does when its run stream gaps or the server restarts

derives.what: a key's `name=value` pairs folded into a line of text
derives.reason: format: `reduce` builds a string here, not a count

runStream.does: a run's events folded into the state a page renders

runTarget.does: what a toolbar's Run button acts on

derives.what: how many assets and sensors a toolbar's Run would act on
derives.reason: page: a count of the listed graph in the open scope by declared kind, for the button's label; reads no state

runsPage.does: the Runs page's program, the query its filters are on the server, and the rows of a run's Steps

derives.what: a node's steps in a run's panel: the failed ones first
derives.reason: presentation: an order of served rows by their served status

sidebar.does: the sidebar's collapse, width and the files and groups it lists

writeAccess.does: whether write controls are drawn: read-only, or not known yet

components/HealthMap.tsx.what: the deepest ring among the map's arcs
components/HealthMap.tsx.reason: layout: geometry of the drawn arcs

components/partitions/KeyHeatmap.tsx.what: a heatmap column's key total: the sum of its bin's per-state counts
components/partitions/KeyHeatmap.tsx.reason: layout: decides whether a column is drawn solid or as a mark; the per-state counts are the served rows' own

layouts/Sidebar.tsx.what: the sidebar's counts: the listed nodes of each kind and with a schedule, in the open pipeline
layouts/Sidebar.tsx.reason: layout: counts of the listed graph (`GET /assets`, which `barca list --json` prints) by declared kind, shown before any state has loaded. `kinds` of `GET /state/rollup` serves the same numbers but arrives later, and three e2e specs hold these counts visible before it does; an earlier switch to the rollup was reverted for that. Kept until the loading state has an answer

pages/GroupedView.tsx.what: a group's panel and row: how many nested groups, assets and checks it holds
pages/GroupedView.tsx.reason: layout: counts of the listed graph by declared kind and of the group tree; reads no state (`check`: see lib/status)

pages/KeysPage.tsx.what: the key explorer's key total: the sum of the served per-state counts of one answer
pages/KeysPage.tsx.reason: presentation: the counts partition the node's keys, so their sum is how many there are; each count is the server's

pages/RunsView.tsx.what: `and N more`: the steps a run's summary does not list
pages/RunsView.tsx.reason: presentation: how many rows of a served list are folded away on screen

pages/SchedulesView.tsx.what: the Schedules header: how many of the listed schedules are late or queue-bound
pages/SchedulesView.tsx.reason: presentation: a count of the page's rows by a flag each was served with (`late`, `queue_bound`)

exemptions.reason: the tag of the panel's own shown-key union, not a cache state
picks the failure roots the server lists for the failures list, which shows each failure's error
the tag of the failures table's own row union (a failure row or a heading), not a root kind
the Runs page's own filter value (`?status=failed`), which asks the server for `not_successful`; not a run's status

page: folds the served status of the run a page started, and a run step's status in the event stream (`queued`, not the cause), into the notice and the feedback a panel shows (queued, running, finished); the status shown is the served one
